request.body: Local mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV; contiguous parts at most ten minutes; serial requests

fields.model: nova-3 preset; explicit editable model ID
fields.language: explicit hint, or detect_language=true when blank
fields.keyterm: repeated query item per comma/newline-separated phrase; literal plus and Unicode preserved

response.text: first alternative from exactly one channel
response.segments: validated utterances, word bounds, or explicitly coarse part boundary
response.words: validated start/end plus punctuated_word/word; omitted if invalid
response.assembly: sample-based offsets; preserve repetitions; no completed partial text after failure/cancel; no cross-part speaker identity

limitations: Automatic language detection may select another supported Deepgram model, per provider documentation.
Independent jobs lose boundary context; real model quality, quotas and account behavior are untested.
The Keychain binding is by origin and speech purpose; keys are not inferred from a URL or shared with text providers.
